output.summary: A flowering annual herb native from Central Mexico to Nicaragua, red amaranth bears tall stems topped with dark pink flower clusters. Its seeds have been eaten in North and Central America since at least 4000 BC, prepared as grain, flour, porridge, popped seeds or sweets; the leaves are cooked like spinach.
